# polvara.me

> > Giorgio Polvara's web development blog focusing on React Testing Library, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript testing patterns.

This site features practical guides and opinions on frontend development, with deep expertise in React Testing Library, type-safe development with TypeScript and Zod, and engineering best practices for building maintainable applications.

## Key Topics

- React Testing Library
- Testing Library
- TypeScript
- React
- Jest
- Zod
- React Query
- React Hooks
- JavaScript
- Component Testing
- Data Fetching
- Technical Debt
- Code Style
- Kent C. Dodds
- Software Engineering Best Practices

## Start Here

- [polvara.me](https://polvara.me): Homepage of Giorgio Polvara, web developer writing about TypeScript & React
- [My Tech Stack](https://polvara.me/tech-stack): Current tech stack including Jest, Vitest, and Testing Library choices

## React Testing Library Guides

- [Five Things You (Probably) Didn't Know About Testing Library](https://polvara.me/posts/five-things-you-didnt-know-about-testing-library): Advanced Testing Library tips: DOM nodes, debug, within, and matchers
- [Testing Library Cheatsheet](https://polvara.me/posts/RTL-cheatsheet): Quick reference cheatsheet for Testing Library methods and patterns
- [How to Test Asynchronous Methods with React Testing Library](https://polvara.me/posts/how-to-test-asynchronous-methods): Testing async methods in componentDidMount with React Testing Library
- [Mocking Context with React Testing Library](https://polvara.me/posts/mocking-context-with-react-testing-library): Testing React Context without jest.mock using wrapper pattern
- [Testing a Custom Select with React Testing Library](https://polvara.me/posts/testing-a-custom-select-with-react-testing-library): Testing react-select, Material-UI, and Ant Design custom select components
- [My Approach When It Comes to Testing](https://polvara.me/posts/my-approach-when-it-comes-to-testing): Testing philosophy using React Testing Library and manual testing approach

## TypeScript & React Patterns

- [Effective Query Functions for React Query with Zod](https://polvara.me/posts/effective-query-functions-for-react-query-with-zod): Type-safe React Query functions with Zod schema validation patterns
- [Fetching Asynchronous Data with React Hooks](https://polvara.me/posts/fetching-asynchronous-data-with-react-hooks): Using useAsync hook from react-use for async data fetching patterns
- [JavaScript Function Composition](https://polvara.me/posts/javascript-function-composition): Functional programming journey from jQuery spaghetti to ES6 composition
- [The Five Primary UX States](https://polvara.me/posts/primary-ux-states): Essential UX states: loading, error, empty, partial, and ideal states

## Engineering & Team Practices

- [The downfall of a software company](https://polvara.me/posts/The+downfall+of+a+software+company): How startups decline when technical debt overtakes development speed
- [Take decisions for the junior developer you haven't hired yet](https://polvara.me/posts/Take+decisions+for+the+junior+developer+you+haven): Engineering decisions should use ESLint automation for future team members
- [How to deprecate a component](https://polvara.me/posts/How+to+deprecate+a+component): Strategy for deprecating components in long-lived codebases with migration
- [How to Start with Open Source](https://polvara.me/posts/how-to-start-with-open-source): Hacktoberfest Barcelona guide to first open-source contributions
